integrity: A general explicit simplicial collapse and homotopy-theoretic proof is supplied. Eight independent graph constructions and two finite verification programs support, but do not replace, the uniform proof.
limitations: Only ordinary five-cut complexes of finite simple graphs with n>=10 and girth at least six. No shellability, equivariant classification, or lower-order assertion; unindexed overlap is possible.
title: A hexagon correction for ordinary five-cut complexes of girth-six graphs
